parameters.name: DagId
parameters.description: The task flow ID. You can obtain this parameter by calling the [ListTaskFlow](~~424565~~) or [ListLhTaskFlowAndScenario](~~426672~~) operation.

parameters.name: DagInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the task flow execution record. You can obtain this parameter by calling the [ListTaskFlowInstance](~~424689~~) operation.

parameters.name: DagVersion
parameters.description: The task flow version number. You can obtain this parameter by calling the [ListDAGVersions](~~465989~~) operation.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The tenant ID.
> You can move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner and view the tenant ID. For more information, see [View tenant information](~~181330~~).
